newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.
Inquiry was moderate, demand light. Bids 68.00, asking
70.00-72.00. Last established price 69.00 on Thursday Feb. 27.
For the week to date 8,800 head confirmed, mostly
previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot
Confirmed - none last week - 33,300 last year - 13,900
Wk to date - 8,800 last week - 79,700 last year - 35,000
